data.title: Cong Gu Huo Niao Kaishi: Long Cheng Fengyun
data.title_japanese: 从姑获鸟开始之龙城风云
title_synonyms: Starting from Guhuo Bird: Dragon City Storm
data.synopsis:
Li Yan, a martial artist with extraordinary talent, has only a few months left to live due to a terminal illness. When he was in a desperate situation, he accidentally met a man who called himself "Tapir" and was sent into a fruit of the "Yanfu Fruit Tree". Li Yan must complete three tasks issued by the system within the time limit, and earn money through boxing matches in exchange for Yanfu points to buy medicine that can cure terminal illnesses. 

As he gets to know Longyuan Fortress where he is located, Li Yan is gradually involved in the disputes in the fortress, and he also realizes that there are other Yanfu Walkers competing with him in secret. After overcoming many difficulties, Li Yan finally successfully completed the task and gained a new life.

(Source: bilibili, translated)

data.title: Fengyun Bian
data.synopsis:
It tells the story of the top warriors Bu Jingyun and Nie Feng. In order to cope with a catastrophe that was about to sweep the entire world, they transformed into quantum states with the help of unknown seniors and mysterious extraterrestrial visitors, and their whereabouts are unknown. Three thousand years later, an asteroid hit the earth, turning the surface into a barbaric wasteland. 

Human beings trapped underground gradually discovered that there is a super power known as "pulse energy" in the human body. Bu Tianyun, an orphan from Dungeon 32, accidentally awakened Bu Jingyun who was sleeping in the meteorite. From then on, he discovered the "pulse energy" potential in his body, and together with Nie Feng's successor Nie Zifeng, embarked on the journey to become " The journey of training as a "pulse warrior" and fighting to protect the world.

(Source: Baidu Baike)

titles.title: Jinwu Guard: The Wind Rises in Jinling

data.title: Jinwu Wei: Feng Qi Jinling
data.title_english: Jinwu Guard: The Wind Rises in Jinling
data.synopsis:
Thunder and fire kill people, rumors spread, and rat-faced sinister soldiers rampage across the imperial capital. Everything seems to point to the secrets of the former dynasty that were wiped out by thunder and fire. A pair of hands brought three very different young men together. Jing Yifei, the cold and proud female master of Jinwu Guard, was ordered to find out the truth about the rat soldiers. Bai Qi, the descendant of Jieyi who lives in seclusion in the mountains, led his master to go down the mountain to find a young machine master to join the Jinwu Guard. But the person he was looking for, Qin Ming, was deceiving and abducting him!? As the three of them continued to work together, they gradually came closer to the truth about Lei Huo.

(Source: iQIYI)

data.title: Yamakawa Junichi Anime Gekijou
data.synopsis: Masaki Michishita, a gay boy attending a preparatory school, finds himself having the urge to pee. He races to the nearest toilet that happens to be in a park, famous for being a gay meet-up spot. He notices Takakazu Abe sitting on a bench in the park and without thinking he says, “Uho! That’s a good man…” As they stare at each other, Takakazu starts unzipping his blue jumpsuit…
data.background: Junichi Yamakawa's famous title, Kuso Miso Technique, which became an internet meme, has been given an animated remake. This collection begins with the title that started what was called the "Yamajun Boom," Kuso Miso Technique, while also bringing his other work, Otokogari (Men Hunting), completely to life! "Uho! That's a good anime..."　 Kuso means "shit" in Japanese. Junichi's famous title refers to a Japanese joke where miso and shit look very similar. (Source: Coolmic)
